name: Portuguese Sign Language
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

sources.citation: Crossref bibliographic searches ('Portuguese Sign Language phonology prosody'; '"língua gestual portuguesa" fonologia'), saved as /
sources.note: Located LGP linguistics items (Morgado & Brito 2022 volume; Carmo, Moita & Mineiro 2017 classifiers; Pratas et al. 2022; Correia & Silva 2023 non-manuals); none is a prosody/stress study of LGP.

sources.citation: Gonçalves, Neide, Mara Moita & Ana Mineiro. 2022. Um olhar diacrónico à variação fonológica e lexical da língua gestual portuguesa no conto Capuchinho Vermelho. In Celda Morgado & Ana Maria Brito (orgs.), Língua Gestual Portuguesa e outras Línguas de Sinais. Estudos Linguísticos, 167-186. Porto: FLUP/CLUP. ISBN 978-989-9082-02-1. doi:10.21747/978-989-9082-02-1/ling
sources.note: Nothing. Sec. 2-3 (pp. 168-171) describe LGP sign phonology in terms of the five parameters (handshape, location, movement, palm orientation, non-manuals), note movement as syllable nucleus in the Prosodic Model, and state (p. 171) that no description of the phonological parameters of LGP yet exists; no statement about stress/accent/prominence. Only 'prosodically more emphatic' child-directed narration is mentioned (p. ~181).
